Consumer Price Index News Release

CONSUMER PRICE INDEX - JULY 2022

The Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U) was unchanged in July on a seasonally adjusted
basis after rising 1.3 percent in June, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported today. Over the
last 12 months, the all items index increased 8.5 percent before seasonal adjustment.

The index for all items less food and energy rose 0.3 percent in July, a smaller increase than in
April, May, or June.

The all items less food and energy index rose 5.9 percent over the last 12 months.
